badges.title: AI and Innovation: How MongoDB Enables a Resilient AI Strategy
badges.description: This skill is for executives or strategic leaders, it reframes AI infrastructure in light of how MongoDB solves many of these issues. Issues such as mangagement of data across multiple tools and diverse data types, both are leading causes for AI projects to fail in practice. The skill discusses how MongoDB solves these issues whilst introducing RAG and AI Agents, two popular techniques used in AI application to highlight how the technology supports these.

badges.title: Building an App with Code Agents and MongoDB
badges.description: This digital credentials validates your ability to understand why MongoDB’s flexible document model outperforms SQL for AI workloads. It recognizes your skills to build modern applications using the MongoDB MCP Server and Agent Skills for accelerated design, refactoring, and query pipeline refinement. You have the ability to implement advanced AI capabilities like vector indexes, semantic search, and auto-embeddings while practicing disciplined, well-documented AI-assisted development workflows.

badges.title: Building RAG Apps Using MongoDB
badges.description: This digital credential validates your knowledge in building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications with MongoDB. It recognizes your understanding of integrating vector search, optimizing retrieval workflows, and enhancing LLM-powered apps.

badges.title: MongoDB Schema Design Optimization
badges.description: This digital credential validates your knowledge of optimizing performance by applying schema design patterns like single collection and bucket. It recognizes your understanding of how to refine data models and effectively scale them in sharded clusters.
